hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.edits[0].file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in *SKILL.md) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$file" ] || exit 0; repo_root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$file")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$repo_root" ] && case "$file" in "$repo_root"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -n "$repo_root" ] || exit 0; line=$(grep "^description:" "$file" | head -1); state="/tmp/skill-desc-hook-$(printf '%s' "$file" | shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1).hash"; new=$(printf '%s' "$line" | shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1); old=$(cat "$state" 2>/dev/null); [ "$new" = "$old" ] && exit 0; printf '%s' "$new" > "$state"; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/measure-description.sh" "$file"
